answer: Detection by seeded audit: honeypot challenges are planted indistinguishably across the assignment graph, machine-vacuous yet valid-looking, leaving no hollow a lazy grader can hide in. A grader who approves one stands out from the juniper of honest jurors, and that single false approval casts an umber mark triggering a slash plus correlation across its other grades, so sybil cross-grading rings that must approve each other blindly light up statistically.
